title: Explicit-bounds external fluid volume construction
description: Creates a box-shaped external volume and subtracts explicitly selected CAD parts on an isolated simulation copy. Does not assign boundaries, mesh, or solve.

probe-transform-api.description: Read-only inventory of STAR 2502 geometry transform API signatures for the upcoming full-360 rotor operation.

expand-rotor-360.description: On an isolated copy, rotate the audited 120-degree PROPELLER fluid-sector part at 120 and 240 degrees about +Z; these parts are not blade solids.

recover-rotor-solids.description: Diagnostic CAD Boolean: subtract three audited 120-degree fluid sectors from their enclosing disk to recover actual rotor solids on an isolated copy.

build.description: Create a block using domain.outer_bounds_m, subtract selected body and rotor CAD parts, save a separate .sim, and export build evidence.

build-cylinder.description: Build a Z-axis cylindrical outer domain from explicit SI dimensions, subtract audited solids, and save an isolated geometry-only .sim.

create-full-region.description: Create a new region with one boundary per split part surface from the audited full-360 cylindrical Boolean output; retain legacy regions for diagnostic comparison.

audit-cylinder-patches.description: Read-only patch ID mapping of explicit cylinder cap and side sample points in the geometry part.

map-full-flow-outer-boundaries.description: Use audited cylinder patch locations to assign inlet, outlet, and radial symmetry boundary types on the new full-360 region in an isolated copy.

remove-legacy-sector-regions.description: On an audited isolated full-domain copy, remove the two original 120-degree sector regions and their three interfaces, leaving only the full-360 flow region.

configure-normal-inlet-outlet.description: Apply explicit CaseSpec speed, temperature, absolute ambient pressure and turbulence values to audited inlet/outlet boundaries of a Z-axis cylinder.

build-mrf-fluid-volumes.description: Build separate stationary outer and blade-subtracted rotating fluid parts from an explicit SI rotor cylinder; geometry-only isolated trial.

create-mrf-regions.description: Create separate fluid regions from audited stationary and rotating MRF Boolean parts; replace the prior full-flow region without creating an interface yet.

audit-mrf-surface-map.description: Read-only patch sampling of outer-cylinder and matching inner-envelope cap/side surfaces in the two MRF fluid parts.

configure-mrf-interfaces.description: Apply audited free-air boundary values, connect three stationary/rotating envelope surface pairs, and assign the audited rotating reference frame on an isolated copy.

configure-mrf-mesh.description: Configure, but do not execute, a two-part MRF surface remesher, trimmer and prism mesh operation with explicit blade and interface controls.

execute-mrf-diagnostic-mesh.description: Execute the previously audited two-part MRF mesh operation on an isolated simulation copy and save volume-cell evidence.

split-mrf-mesh-operations.description: Split a joint two-part MRF mesh operation into separate stationary and rotating operations after a documented joint-surface meshing failure.

execute-mrf-split-diagnostic-mesh.description: Mesh the rotating and stationary MRF fluid parts separately, saving a rotating-region checkpoint and a two-region diagnostic mesh.

adjust-mrf-rotating-prisms.description: On an isolated copy, reduce the audited rotating-region prism-layer count after STAR mesh quality flags while keeping stationary settings unchanged.
